title: Online Excel Editor — Edit XLSX Workbooks in Your Browser
description: Online Excel workbook editor powered by OnlyOffice. Free durable library in this browser; optional cloud storage when you need the same file across devices.
ogDescription: Edit Excel workbooks online — free local library in this browser, or optional cloud storage across devices.
sub: Upload and save workbooks in this browser for free. Add optional cloud storage when the same file needs to follow you across devices.

recent.label: Continue editing
recent.note: This-device library stays in IndexedDB until you delete it. Crash recovery copies still expire after 7 days on the history page. Cloud workbooks sync when you are signed in with a plan.

loved.label: Built for creators, startups, and teams who want Excel in the browser

features.h2: Say goodbye to bloated suites. Welcome to focused productivity.
features.p: OnlyOffice in the tab for free local edits. Sign in only when you want the same workbook on every device — see Pricing for cloud plans.

items.p: Formulas, charts, sheets and formatting via OnlyOffice WebAssembly — no desktop Office required.
Upload and save into this browser's durable library with no account. Seven-day AutoRecover remains for crash recovery only.
Optional account storage so a workbook can follow you across devices. Plans and quotas live on the Pricing page.

essentials.p: Built for opening attachments, fixing cells, and keeping formulas intact — not for replacing every Excel power feature.

items.label: Honest fit
items.p: Great for open–edit–download and light formulas. For VBA macros, heavy Power Query, or live multi-user co-editing, stick with Excel or Google Sheets.

items.label: Organization
items.p: Spreadsheets are the product. The same engine still opens Word, PowerPoint, PDF and OpenDocument when you need them.

items.label: Cloud library
items.p: Sign in, choose a cloud plan on Pricing, then browse, open, and autosave files in your account — pick up on another device.

items.label: Offline ready
items.p: Once editor assets are cached, keep editing a local file without the network. Cloud save waits until you are online.

band.h2: Ready for a faster, lighter spreadsheet workflow?
band.p: Save free in this browser. Add cloud storage only when the workbook needs to follow you across devices.

foot.blurb: The lightweight online Excel and document editor — free local library, optional cloud storage.

faqLd.a: No for local editing. Open a .xlsx free without signing in — save into this browser's library, or use seven-day AutoRecover. Sign in and pick a cloud plan on the Pricing page only when the same file must follow you across devices.

faqLd.q: What happens if I close the tab?
faqLd.a: This-device library files stay until you delete them. Signed-in cloud workbooks are written back by save and autosave. Separately, crash recovery copies can stay for 7 days — see the history page.

faqLd.q: Is this a full Excel replacement?
faqLd.a: No. It is built for opening attachments, everyday formulas, and format-preserving edits without installing Office. For VBA macros, heavy Power Query, or live multi-user co-editing, use Excel or Google Sheets.
Excel (.xlsx) is the primary product. The same editor also opens Word (DOCX), PowerPoint (PPTX), PDF and CSV, powered by OnlyOffice in WebAssembly.
